This bit is used to configure the position of carrier wave for channel n. 1'h0: add carrier wave on low level. 1'h1: add carrier wave on high level.
This is the carrier modulation enable-bit for channel n. 1: Add carrier modulation on the output signal. 0: No carrier modulation is added on output signal.

1: Add carrier modulation on the output signal only at data-sending state for channel n. 0: Add carrier modulation on the output signal at data-sending state and idle state for channel n. Only valid when RMT_CARRIER_EN_CHn is 1.
This field is used to configure the maximum number of memory blocks allocated to channel n.
This field is used to configure the divider for clock of channel n.
Set this bit to stop the transmitter of channel n sending data out.

This is the output enable-bit for channel n in idle state. 0: the output level in idle state is determined by the level field of an end-marker. 1: the output level in idle state is determined by RMT_IDLE_OUT_LV_CHn.
This bit configures the level of output signal for channel n when the transmitter is in idle state.

Set this bit to enable wrap TX mode for channel n. In this mode, if the TX data size is larger than the channel's RAM block size, the transmitter continues transmitting the first data again to the last data in loops.

Set this bit to enable continuous TX mode for channel n. In this mode, the transmitter starts its transmission from the first data, and in the following transmission: if an end-marker is encountered, the transmitter starts transmitting data from the first data again; if no end-marker is encountered, the transmitter starts transmitting the first data again when the last data is transmitted.
Set this bit to reset RAM W/R address for channel n when accessed by APB FIFO.
Set this bit to reset RAM read address accessed by the transmitter of channel n.
Set this bit to start sending data in channel n.

This bit is used to configure the position of carrier demodulation for channel m. 1'h0: demodulate low-level carrier wave. 1'h1: demodulate high-level carrier wave.
